GOOGLE CALENDAR, CONNECTED TO YOUR SITE

Keep your community
in the loop.

Make event changes easy for staff and store owners—and keep players up to date as plans change.

My calendar system connects your store’s Google Calendar to your website. Add a tournament, change a start time, or cancel an event in Google Calendar, and your site updates in real time.

Staff and store owners can adjust event details as things happen, right in Google Calendar. No coding needed, and no extra website updates to manage.
